root_idea.summary: A core of gathering together, drawing near, and joining what is separated.
root_idea.development: The root develops from collecting or consolidating what is dispersed to meanings of approach and visitation, slight contact or near commission, congregation, and things that befall.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form لَمَّ; the Quranic occurrences are its imperative stem in هَلُمَّ.
Displayed as the Quranic noun لَمَمٌ.
Displayed as the verbal noun لَمٌّ, despite the QAC adjective tag, because the supplied derived-nominal evidence identifies it as a verbal noun.

senses.definition: To gather or bring together; in the imperative construction هَلُمَّ, to call someone to come forward or to bring something forward.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences use the imperative stem لُمَّ within هَلُمَّ. Context accounts for renderings such as “come” and “bring forward” without requiring separate lexical senses.

senses.definition: Minor sins or brief approaches to wrongdoing that fall short of full commission; hence small faults.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic exception from major sins and indecencies, the term can denote approaching a sin and then refraining from it, as well as the resulting notion of a minor lapse.

senses.definition: Gathering or taking things together as a whole; altogether.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adverbially in the Quranic expression أَكْلًا لَمًّا, describing the collective taking or consuming of something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repair, reconcile, and consolidate what has become disordered or unsettled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used transitively of disorganized affairs or a state of scattered disorder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make the hair into a لِمَّة hairstyle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II; the hairstyle is hair extending below the earlobe.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come to someone or a people, alight at their abode as a guest, or visit briefly; hence to come near.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is attested with بِـ and عَلَى; the visit may be covert, light, hasty, or occasional.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To know or understand the meaning of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the Form IV construction with بِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To commit a sin or offense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended Form IV use with بِـ.
An extended intransitive use of the Form IV verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be collected or accumulated; for people or groups, to gather or congregate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII; the reflexive plural use describes people collecting themselves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particle that negates an imperfect verb with past-time force: “did not.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It governs the imperfect verb; with the interrogative alif it can introduce a confirmatory or rhetorical question.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particle meaning “not yet,” denying that an expected action has occurred.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an imperfect verb, leaving the action open to subsequent occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A temporal particle meaning “when” or “as soon as”; in some analyses, “since” or “because.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Introduces a temporal clause, with the precise temporal or causal force determined by the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particle of exception equivalent to إِلَّا: “but,” “except,” or “only.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may precede a nominal proposition and, in a reported reading, a verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slight taint, touch, or infection of insanity, including a slight diabolical possession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The affliction is also described as a touch from the jinn.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hair extending below the lobe of the ear; a hairstyle of that length.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation for the hair or hairstyle itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A misfortune that befalls a person in the present world.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived feminine noun for an adversity or worldly calamity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A boy having a لِمَّة hairstyle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived descriptive noun referring specifically to a boy characterized by that hairstyle.
